title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Carrying Out Education on the Socialist Concept of Rule of Law
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Carrying out Education on the Socialist Concept of Rule of Law

Fa Fa [2006] No. 10

The Higher People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government, the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army, and the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the Higher People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

General Secretary Hu Jintao pointed out: "Carrying out education on the socialist concept of rule of law is a major measure to strengthen the political and ideological construction of the political and legal contingent." Recently, the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission held a seminar to focus on the issue of the socialist concept of rule of law. Comrade Luo Gan delivered an important speech on carrying out education on the socialist concept of rule of law, requiring that this educational activity be carried out in the national political and legal system. In accordance with the overall arrangements of the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission, and in light of the actual ideological conditions of the court contingent and the actual work of the courts, we hereby notify the following regarding the carrying out of education on the socialist concept of rule of law within the court system:

I. Fully Recognize the Importance of Carrying out Education on the Socialist Concept of Rule of Law, and Unify Thinking with the Spirit of the Central Authorities

The socialist concept of rule of law is an important theoretical concept proposed by the Party Central Committee based on the overall situation of the socialist modernization drive, adhering to the guidance of Marxist legal theory, and on the basis of earnestly summing up the experience of China's socialist rule of law construction and drawing on the achievements of world rule of law civilization. It marks a deeper understanding and grasp by the Party of the laws governing the construction of a socialist country ruled by law with Chinese characteristics and the laws governing the governance of the Chinese Communist Party. The deployment by the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission of in-depth education on the socialist concept of rule of law in national political and legal organs is an objective need to adapt to the new situation and new tasks of political and legal work in the new period, an objective need to ensure the socialist direction of political and legal work, and an objective need to solve practical problems in law enforcement and build a high-quality political and legal contingent.

As Comrade Luo Gan pointed out in his speech at the seminar on the socialist concept of rule of law, in recent years, national courts, guided by Deng Xiaoping Theory, have earnestly practiced the important thought of "Three Represents," fully implemented the Scientific Outlook on Development, closely focused on the work theme of "justice and efficiency," and paid close attention to the three major tasks of adjudication work, judicial reform, and contingent building. Ideological and political construction, judicial system construction, and capacity and work style construction have been continuously strengthened. The guiding ideology of judges and other staff members of serving the people through justice has been further established, and their ability to maintain fairness and justice has gradually improved. Generally speaking, the people's courts have adhered to the socialist political direction in all their work, earnestly implemented the Party's line, principles, and policies, strived to follow the laws of judicial work, adhered to strict law enforcement and full performance of functions, and played an irreplaceable role in maintaining stability and serving the overall situation. Considerable progress has also been made in contingent building, judicial reform, and infrastructure construction. The masses are satisfied with the court work and the mainstream of the contingent. However, China's socialist construction is in a rare important period of strategic opportunities, but also in a period of prominent contradictions among the people, high incidence of criminal offences, and complex struggles against enemies. Facing the new situation and new tasks, our ability to combat crime, mediate disputes, and maintain stability is not yet strong enough; the level of serious, fair, and civilized law enforcement is not yet high enough; the ability to resist and overcome the negative influence of Western legal thought, "leftist" concepts, and feudal privilege thinking is not yet strong enough; and problems of non-standard, non-strict, unfair, uncivilized, and non-incorruptible judicial behavior still occur from time to time. Firmly establishing the socialist concept of rule of law is an objective need for the people's courts to implement the Scientific Outlook on Development, adhere to the socialist direction, adapt to the requirements of the new situation and new tasks, and give full play to the function of adjudication. It is also an inherent requirement for strengthening the ideological and political construction and professional ethics construction of the court contingent, improving judicial capacity and level, and solving the outstanding problems existing within the contingent itself.

The socialist concept of rule of law is essentially the basic guiding ideology for political and legal work, concerning the direction of the people's courts' work in the new period. People's courts at all levels should attach great importance to it, unify their thinking with the spirit and requirements of the Central Authorities, and grasp the carrying out of education on the socialist concept of rule of law as a major current political task. Consciously rectify judicial thinking and judicial concepts, fundamentally solve major issues such as for whom to exercise power, for whom to administer justice, and how to administer justice, further solve problems that restrict judicial fairness and are strongly reflected by the masses, and provide more powerful judicial guarantees for implementing the "Eleventh Five-Year Plan" and building a socialist harmonious society.

II. Deeply Understand the Profound Connotation of the Socialist Concept of Rule of Law, and Comprehensively and Accurately Grasp the Theoretical Essence and Practical Requirements

The socialist concept of rule of law is the essence and soul of socialist rule of law. It is the unity of the Party's leadership, the people being the masters of the country, and the rule of law. Its connotation is very rich, and education needs to be focused on five aspects.

First, firmly establish the concept of ruling the country according to law and uphold the authority of the Constitution and laws. The core of ruling the country according to law is to establish and realize the orientation of taking the Constitution and laws as the most authoritative value for governing the country. As an adjudicatory organ, the people's court must always adhere to the principle of equality before the law, respect and safeguard the litigation rights and legitimate rights and interests of every party; administer justice strictly and fairly, strive to maintain the unity and dignity of the socialist legal system; strictly act according to law, adhere to the principle that powers are conferred by law, that powers must entail responsibilities, that the exercise of powers must be subject to supervision, and that violations of the law must be investigated; and through strict and fair adjudication, establish and safeguard the credibility and dignity of the people's court.

Second, firmly establish the concept of administering justice for the people and safeguard the fundamental interests of the overwhelming majority of the people according to law. Treat adjudication activities as a means to protect and realize the fundamental interests of the people, and implement the work guiding principle of "impartial justice, wholehearted dedication to the people" in every adjudication link. In accordance with the requirements of administering justice for the people, earnestly implement various measures to safeguard civil rights and facilitate litigation, further transform judicial style, regulate judicial conduct, improve judicial efficiency, properly handle various disputes involving the actual interests of the people, maximize the resolution of contradictions and settlement of disputes, and convey judicial fairness and judicial warmth to every party and the broad masses through adjudication activities.

Third, firmly establish the concept of fairness and justice, and continuously improve the ability to maintain social fairness and justice. As the legal awareness and rights consciousness of the masses increase, the demands of all sectors of society for fairness and justice continue to rise. The people's court should place greater prominence on safeguarding and realizing social fairness and justice according to law. Consciously adhere to the principles of legality and reasonableness, correctly reflect and take into account the interests of different social groups according to law, properly coordinate the interest relationships of all parties, exercise discretionary power lawfully and properly, and ensure the realization of fairness and justice in the whole society to the greatest extent; consciously adhere to the principle of timeliness and efficiency, strive to improve the quality and efficiency of cases; consciously adhere to the principle of equal emphasis on substantive justice and procedural justice, enable people to see justice done in a visible way, and enhance acceptance of judgments.

Fourth, firmly establish the concept of serving the overall situation, and promote comprehensive and coordinated economic and social development. Guide judges and other staff members to continuously enhance political responsibility and sense of mission, correctly handle the relationship between serving the overall situation and performing their own duties, and between strictly performing adjudication duties according to law and serving the overall situation; correctly handle the relationship between overall interests and local interests. Always adhere to maintaining reform, development, and stability as their sacred duty and the central task of the court. Overcome the thinking and tendency of handling cases in isolation, give full play to the adjudication function closely围绕 the construction of a socialist harmonious society, and strive to achieve the unity of legal effect and social effect.

Fifth, firmly establish the concept of Party leadership, and always adhere to the Party's absolute leadership over court work. Deeply understand that Party leadership and socialist rule of law are fundamentally consistent. Always adhere to the Party's absolute leadership over court work; always adhere to the guiding position of Marxism in the field of political and legal ideology; always adhere to the correct direction of adjudication work; always arm the minds of all judges and other staff members with correct thinking; always maintain the political essence of the court contingent being forever loyal to the Party, loyal to the country, loyal to the people, and loyal to the law. In practical work, consciously unify adherence to Party leadership and consolidation of the Party's ruling status with the maintenance of socialist rule of law; unify the implementation of the Party's line, principles, and policies with strict law enforcement; unify adherence to independent exercise of powers according to law with conscious acceptance of Party leadership and People's Congress supervision.

The five aspects of the socialist concept of rule of law complement each other. Among them, ruling the country according to law is the core content of socialist rule of law; administering justice for the people is the essential requirement of socialist rule of law; fairness and justice is the value pursuit of socialist rule of law; serving the overall situation is an important mission of socialist rule of law; and Party leadership is the fundamental guarantee of socialist rule of law. In the educational activity, guide judges and other staff members to deeply understand the profound connotation of the socialist concept of rule of law, comprehensively and accurately grasp the theoretical essence and practical requirements, strive to clarify various vague understandings, and drive conscious action with theoretical clarity.

III. Grasp Key Links to Ensure the Educational Activity Achieves Practical Results

Education on the socialist concept of rule of law is an in-depth ideological and political education. Courts at all levels should adhere to the principle of positive education as the mainstay, persist in earnest study and improvement of ideological understanding throughout; persist in linking with reality, improving work style, and promoting various tasks throughout; persist in combining ideological education with special rectification and system construction. Through study and education, achieve further rectification of judicial concepts, further enhancement of judicial capacity, further standardization of judicial conduct, further clarification of reform direction, further strengthening of contingent building, and further improvement of the people's satisfaction with the court contingent and court work. To achieve the expected effect, focus on four key links:

First, study documents and raise awareness. Organize all court staff to earnestly study General Secretary Hu Jintao's important instructions on carrying out education on the socialist concept of rule of law, and his important speeches on adhering to the Scientific Outlook on Development and building a socialist harmonious society; study Deng Xiaoping's theory of socialism with Chinese characteristics and the expositions of the three generations of leaders on the concept of rule of law; study the General Principles of the Constitution and the Constitution of the Chinese Communist Party; study Comrade Luo Gan's report at the 2005 National Political and Legal Work Conference and his important speech at the seminar on the socialist concept of rule of law; and study the "Reader on Education on the Socialist Concept of Rule of Law" compiled by the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission. Guide everyone to deeply understand the spirit and essence, and deeply recognize the importance and necessity of carrying out education on the socialist concept of rule of law from the height of adapting to the new situation and new tasks, ensuring the correct direction of court work, and building a high-quality court contingent. To ensure the learning effect, methods such as combining centralized classes with self-study, special guidance with discussion and research, and theoretical guidance with practical education can be adopted. The Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission and China Central Television will cooperate in organizing巡回 lectures, broadcasting lectures, and distributing CDs. Courts in various locations should make full use of these resources to organize study and education.

Second, clean up thinking and clarify the source. Focus on the five special topics of ruling the country according to law, administering justice for the people, fairness and justice, serving the overall situation, and Party leadership, and organize in-depth discussions one by one. Guide judges and other staff members to earnestly clean up their own thinking, find gaps in guiding ideology and actual work, overcome the negative influence of Western legal thought, eliminate "leftist" concepts and remnants of feudal privilege thinking, and further firmly establish correct world outlook, outlook on life, values, and awareness of clean governance, awareness of proceeding from China's national conditions, awareness of strictly acting according to law, awareness of administering justice for the people, awareness of equal protection, awareness of serving the overall work of the whole Party and the whole country, and Party spirit awareness. Truly ensure that correct thinking is upheld, erroneous thinking is overcome, vague thinking is clarified, concepts that are not suitable for the new situation are updated, and clarify what to uphold, what to oppose, and what to prevent.

Third, focus on training and in-depth research. Courts at all levels should promptly hold special report meetings on education on the socialist concept of rule of law and special research seminars for leading cadres. In addition to inviting leaders and experts to give lectures, the "first in command" and Party group members of the court should personally give lectures based on actual conditions. Higher and intermediate courts should conduct centralized training for leading cadres at and above the middle level in courts under their jurisdiction, especially the heads of people's tribunals. The total time for research and training should not be less than 10 days. Basic-level courts, in light of their own existing problems, especially problems identified in the special rectification activity and problems reflected in litigation-related petitions and letters, should conduct special training for business backbones and staff in key positions in accordance with the requirements of the socialist concept of rule of law. The Supreme People's Court will, at an appropriate time, hold research seminars for presidents of intermediate and basic-level courts and research seminars for directors of political departments.

Fourth, conduct examinations and spot checks to ensure effectiveness. In accordance with the unified deployment of the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission, courts at all levels should organize knowledge assessments on the socialist concept of rule of law in the fourth quarter. To ensure effectiveness, methods such as unified organization by the higher people's court or unified question setting can be adopted. Those who fail the assessment should undergo off-duty training to make up for deficiencies. The Supreme People's Court and higher people's courts should strengthen inspection and guidance throughout the entire process of the activity, with a focus on supervising and inspecting whether the education plan is feasible, whether work organization is effective, whether thought cleaning is profound, whether problem solving is thorough, whether adjudication quality has improved, and whether people's satisfaction has increased. Before the end of the year, the Supreme People's Court will send inspection teams to conduct spot checks on the education activities of courts in various regions. Units that do not meet the requirements after spot checks will be required to make up for deficiencies within a specified period.

In the education on the socialist concept of rule of law, leading cadres at all levels should take the lead in studying, researching, cleaning up thinking, and rectifying, playing an exemplary role. At the same time, encourage and guide judges and other staff members to engage in self-education, self-improvement, and self-perfection. In terms of educational forms, attention should be paid to diversification and comprehensiveness, adopting methods that are popular, easy to accept, and loved by the masses. Attention should be paid to the role of court culture in education on the socialist concept of rule of law, integrating education into culture, and continuously strengthening and deepening the educational effect. Special attention should be paid to using the guiding and spurring role of typical examples of both positive and negative aspects. Courts at all levels should earnestly explore and establish a group of advanced models who study and practice the socialist concept of rule of law, vigorously promote judicial righteousness. The Supreme People's Court will actively coordinate and launch new major models at the appropriate time. At the same time, seize negative examples that deviate from the socialist concept of rule of law and are illegal or disciplinary, and carry out warning education at the appropriate time.

Emphasize the promotional role of publicity work in education on the socialist concept of rule of law. Courts at all levels should actively communicate with news media, vigorously publicize the socialist concept of rule of law, and publicize advanced models and work measures that embody these concepts. Give full play to the role of industry newspapers and periodicals. Newspapers and periodicals such as "People's Court Daily," "People's Justice," "Application of Law," and "China Trial" should closely cooperate with the educational activity, organize articles, open columns, and expand publicity on the content of the socialist concept of rule of law and positive models.

IV. Closely Link with Reality, Comprehensively Promote Court Contingent Building and Various Tasks

The carrying out of education on the socialist concept of rule of law must be closely linked with reality. First, closely link with education on the socialist concept of honor and disgrace. The socialist concept of honor and disgrace is the most important ideological and moral foundation of the socialist concept of rule of law. Combine clarifying the guiding ideology of judicial work with comprehensively strengthening ideological, moral, and work style construction, effectively improving the political, professional quality and ideological and moral cultivation of the court contingent. Second, closely link with the special rectification activity of standardizing judicial conduct. Implement the basic principles, main contents, and requirements of the socialist concept of rule of law into the construction of judicial standardization. Firmly grasp the key posts and links where problems are prone to occur, further strengthen system construction, and gradually implement the goals of standardizing law enforcement within three years proposed by the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission. That is: establish and improve the law enforcement responsibility system, the law enforcement quality and efficiency evaluation system, and the law enforcement supervision system; strengthen the construction of informatization in law enforcement work and long-term education and training mechanisms. At the same time, grasp the implementation of the "Code of Conduct for Judges (Trial)," embedding the construction of judicial standardization into habit formation education. Third, closely link with the reform of the judicial system and working mechanisms. Further emancipate the mind, update concepts, guide and promote reform with correct concepts, accelerate the breaking of institutional and mechanistic obstacles affecting and restricting court work, and ensure the implementation of the tasks of the "Second Five-Year Reform Outline." Fourth, closely link with the actual work of the court. Earnestly find and solve ideological and understanding problems existing in the judiciary; more importantly, properly handle the ten aspects of relationships proposed by the National Conference of Presidents of Higher People's Courts in accordance with the basic requirements of the Scientific Outlook on Development and the socialist concept of rule of law; earnestly implement the various work tasks determined for this year; and make every effort to maintain social harmony and stability.

V. Strengthen Leadership, Make Overall Arrangements, Focus on Building Long-Term Mechanisms

Conducting education on the socialist concept of rule of law is a major measure to promote the rule of law and a major event in current court work. Party groups of courts at all levels should, under the leadership of the local Party committee, earnestly organize and implement the education based on the spirit of the Central Authorities and the arrangements of the Supreme People's Court and local Party committees, combining with actual conditions. The main leaders should personally take charge and assume overall responsibility. Party group members should implement the tasks separately. Political work, discipline inspection, and other comprehensive departments should closely cooperate and form a joint force, enabling the educational activity to be carried out solidly and in-depth.

Education on the socialist concept of rule of law is rich in content and has high requirements. Courts at all levels should make overall arrangements, formulate feasible implementation plans based on the actual conditions of their own regions and units, not only ensuring that judges and other staff members are generally educated but also persisting in promoting work through education, embodying the effectiveness of the educational activity in new thinking, new measures in work, and new appearances in the contingent, truly achieving "no conflict between the two, promoting both." The education activity plans of the higher people's courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government should be reported to the Political Department of the Supreme People's Court. The Supreme People's Court will compile and distribute "Special Issues of Situation Reflections" to strengthen information exchange and activity guidance.

The formation of ideology is a long-term process. Courts at all levels should not only concentrate on education to ensure phased results but also continuously summarize experience and further establish and improve long-term mechanisms. Incorporate education on the socialist concept of rule of law as a compulsory course into the education and training plans of their own units, continuously enrich the content of education, continuously enhance the pertinence of education, and persist in carrying out this education deeply and persistently.

May 8, 2006
